focus: Angle 2: README.md/SKILL.md core-vs-addon labels for the six contested docs vs manifest and create.sh

label: README trigger table promises ask-surfaces that do not exist for goal/resource-map/context-index
claim: explicit-option = written when you ask for it (decision-record, resource-map, context-index, before-after, timeline, roadmap, goal); machine contract is spec-kit-docs.json
groundTruth: Only before-after/timeline/roadmap/decision-record have an ask-surface: --with-lazy-addons with the 4-doc list hardcoded (create.sh:393, help :282-283); goal/resource-map/context-index have 0 hits in create.sh; the pointed-to machine contract's documents[] is implementation-dead (f-iter001-001)
recommendation: fix (align table to acting truth) or document (if ask-surfaces exist outside the audited surface)

label: README level table misdescribes L2/L3/L3+ rows
claim: L3 = Level 2 + decision-record.md (optional, created on request); L3+ = + approval workflow, compliance checkpoints, stakeholder matrix; L2 = acceptance-criteria.md (optional, warns if absent)
groundTruth: decision-record.md is in lazyAddonDocs at EVERY level (manifest:189,565,1059,1613; create.sh:283 all are valid at every level); L3+ artifacts are sectionGates (compliance-verify :1310-1312,1873-1875) and inline-gated anchors in core/spec.md.tmpl (:329 approval-workflow, :369 stakeholder-matrix), not files; acceptance-criteria.md is scaffolded BY DEFAULT at L2/3/3+ (create.sh:431-433) and the promised warn has no mechanism
recommendation: fix the three rows to the acting truth

label: README loop-emission claim wrong on path and provenance; conflates two same-named artifacts
claim: Deep-research and deep-review loops emit resource-map.md automatically next to review-report.md; render it from templates/addons/resource-map.md.tmpl when wanted
groundTruth: Loops emit at {artifact_dir}/resource-map.md (deep-research-confirm.yaml:187; deep-review-auto.yaml:161) = the research/lineage dir, not the packet root beside review/review-report.md; content is emitResourceMap extraction from loop deltas (reduce-state.cjs:14,1536-1538,1660 via shared/synthesis/resource-map.cjs), NOT a render of the addon template
recommendation: fix (real path + provenance) and document the addon-template vs loop-emission artifact distinction

label: resource-map.md exists in three systems vocabularies and zero enforcement paths
claim: resource-map.md: owner author, creationTrigger explicit-option, absenceBehavior warn; SKILL:65 optional at any level; README:168 optional path ledger
groundTruth: resource-map.md appears in NONE of the 7 level contracts (not in any addon array); validator addon scan = optionalAddonDocs∪lazyAddonDocs minus FREEFORM {review/review-report.md, research/research.md} (orchestrator.ts:507-510; spec-doc-structure.ts:200) so it is never structure-checked; no scaffold/flag path writes it; the warn has no producer; yet discovery indexes it as canonical (spec-doc-discovery.ts:139-145; runtime/README.md:154)
recommendation: fix (add to lazyAddonDocs where produced, or give the addon template an ask-surface) else document as extension-authored-only

label: SKILL template/ToC gates omit 4 template-backed docs
claim: MUST-use-templates list and ToC list cover 9-10 named docs
groundTruth: before-after.md, timeline.md, roadmap.md, goal.md are versioned gate-bearing templates (manifest versions :17-21; documents[] :128-144,158-162; L1 sectionGates.goal.md :521) with the same inline-gate render path, but an agent hand-authoring them is under no template or ToC obligation by SKILL:61/494
recommendation: document the principle (any doc with a versioned .tmpl is template-gated) instead of enumerating

direction: resource-map.md is validated as a present addon when it exists
reason: orchestrator.ts:507-510 scans optionalAddonDocs∪lazyAddonDocs only; resource-map.md is in neither array in any of the 7 contracts
reduce-state.cjs:14 uses shared/synthesis/resource-map.cjs over lineage deltas; the addon template is only a manual render source (README:173, SKILL:65)

answer: NO - five concrete prose-vs-enforcement mismatches: nonexistent ask-surfaces for 3 of 7 explicit-option docs (README:184 vs create.sh:393); level-table misdescriptions of L2/L3/L3+ (README:149-151 vs manifest:189,565,1059,1613 + create.sh:431-433); loop-emission path+provenance wrong (README:173 vs reduce-state.cjs:1660); resource-map.md claimed-optional-but-never-contracted-or-validated (SKILL:65 + manifest:98-102 vs all 7 contracts + orchestrator.ts:507-510); SKILL gates omit 4 template-backed docs (SKILL:61,494 vs manifest:4-22).
